about: Which user-role records are not the person speaking. A record is not the person's words when, after every block below is removed (outer tag with everything inside it), nothing is left; or when it starts with one of the prefixes. If any text is left, it is the person's words and is kept verbatim. The writing loop reads this same file, so the two cannot drift apart. "inbox": 1 says this plugin also speaks for other sources: a source writes what it would say into <state dir>/inbox/<source>.<...>.json and the plugin says it, once, under one rule for which turns get what; without this key the writing loop speaks for itself.
prefixes: The app was quit while you were working.
